title: Qualify complete AC1018 NOD output through AC1024 DXF

independentReader.scope: Corroborates the physical NOD's nine named key-to-handle edges and DICTIONARY/DICTIONARYWDFLT object classes; this reader output does not establish this project's serialized DXF.

profile.operation: AC1018 physical DWG partial conversion to AC1024 ASCII and Binary DXF
profile.scopeBoundary: This qualifies the NOD callback's complete body and its nine emitted target identities/types/owners for this source witness. It does not qualify the semantic completeness of each child object's body or whole-document output.

proof: The bounded AC1018 profile requires the exact nine source keys, unique non-null targets, typed DICTIONARY or DICTIONARYWDFLT models, and source NOD ownership; the selected source model is frozen and checked again before publication.

Staged OBJECTS inspection verifies every target's unique emitted record identity, type, handle and owner. The production decoder then compares the entire ordered NOD, common fields, hard-owner/cloning flags, key names, mapped handles and handle roles against the frozen source model.
Fresh production-reader readback checks all nine ordered keys, unique target handles, DICTIONARY versus DICTIONARYWDFLT target classes, and NOD ownership.

No output qualification is published on refusal. A deliberately invalid LAYOUT block reference preserves the destination sentinel and existing qualification set; restoring it permits same-adapter retry and fresh readback.
